# Requirements Quality Checklist: Tab Title Data State

**Purpose**: Reviewer/PR check of requirement quality for the tab title feature (standard depth; focus: state mapping and consistency with the badge)
**Created**: 2026-11-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit.checklist`.
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. Mark `[x]` only when the reviewer judges the criterion satisfied for the requirements. It does not mean implementation is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are title requirements defined for every value of the source status (live, estimated, no data) and for the "no response yet" case? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001..003]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the title requirement stated for the stale-connection state, where the badge shows an extra stale indication? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the title behavior defined when the page is unloaded or the console component unmounts? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is "the state shown by the header badge" defined precisely (label text only, or label plus detail and stale marker)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK005 Is "no response has been received yet" distinguished from "request failed after a success" in a single, unambiguous rule? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the exact separator and character (`·`, U+00B7) of the title format specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001..003]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Do FR-003 (no response yet → `Sin datos`) and FR-006 (initial title `Central en vivo`) define a non-overlapping boundary between "before the console loads" and "console rendered"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 Does the plan's label-table export name match the identifier that exists in the codebase? [Conflict, Plan §Structure vs tasks T001]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the terms "data state", "source status" and "badge state" used consistently across spec, plan and tasks? [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK010 Can SC-002 ("can tell live from estimated from no data") be objectively measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "the same update" in SC-003 defined in measurable terms (same render, same tick)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK012 Does every FR map to an acceptance scenario or success criterion (FR-005, FR-006 have no scenario)? [Traceability, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Are rapid consecutive status changes addressed in requirements? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements defined for the background-tab update expectation, including browser timer throttling of the data refresh? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK015 Are accessibility expectations (screen-reader title announcement, text not relying on color) stated or explicitly excluded? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the requirement that tests be independent of time zone and locale recorded as a requirement rather than only as a plan constraint? [Gap, Plan §Constraints]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK017 Is the assumption that the badge already derives from the source status validated against the current header behavior? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the assumption that Spanish labels need no localization recorded with an owner or review point? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the criterion.
- `/speckit.implement` reads checkbox state and does not modify markers.
